source: AMA CPT E/M Medical Decision Making table (licensed CPT content)
note: Structured form of the MDM level-selection table from the CPT E/M guidelines. Contains level definitions only — no CPT codes; the level a given E/M code requires is read from that code's own descriptor ('... LOW level of medical decision making ...'), so this file stays valid across code-set updates.
selection_rule: The level of MDM is met when 2 of the 3 elements (problems addressed, data reviewed and analyzed, risk of management) are met or exceeded.
time_rule: Total time on the date of the encounter may be used for code selection instead of MDM only when the total time is documented in the note; the minute threshold is stated in each code's own descriptor.

risk_of_management.label: Minimal risk of morbidity from additional diagnostic testing or treatment

problems_addressed: 2 or more self-limited or minor problems

data_reviewed_analyzed.label: Limited — must meet the requirements of at least 1 of 2 categories

categories.name: Category 1: Tests and documents
categories.requirement: Any combination of 2 from the following
items: Review of prior external note(s) from each unique source
Review of the result(s) of each unique test
Ordering of each unique test

categories.name: Category 2: Assessment requiring an independent historian(s)

risk_of_management.label: Low risk of morbidity from additional diagnostic testing or treatment

problems_addressed: 1 or more chronic illnesses with exacerbation, progression, or side effects of treatment
1 undiagnosed new problem with uncertain prognosis

data_reviewed_analyzed.label: Moderate — must meet the requirements of at least 1 of 3 categories

categories.name: Category 1: Tests, documents, or independent historian(s)
categories.requirement: Any combination of 3 from the following
items: Review of prior external note(s) from each unique source
Review of the result(s) of each unique test
Ordering of each unique test
Assessment requiring an independent historian

categories.name: Category 2: Independent interpretation of tests
categories.requirement: Independent interpretation of a test performed by another physician/other qualified health care professional (not separately reported)

categories.name: Category 3: Discussion of management or test interpretation
categories.requirement: Discussion of management or test interpretation with external physician/other qualified health care professional/appropriate source (not separately reported)

risk_of_management.label: Moderate risk of morbidity from additional diagnostic testing or treatment
examples: Decision regarding minor surgery with identified patient or procedure risk factors
Decision regarding elective major surgery without identified patient or procedure risk factors
Diagnosis or treatment significantly limited by social determinants of health

problems_addressed: 1 or more chronic illnesses with severe exacerbation, progression, or side effects of treatment
1 acute or chronic illness or injury that poses a threat to life or bodily function

data_reviewed_analyzed.label: Extensive — must meet the requirements of at least 2 of 3 categories

categories.name: Category 1: Tests, documents, or independent historian(s)
categories.requirement: Any combination of 3 from the following
items: Review of prior external note(s) from each unique source
Review of the result(s) of each unique test
Ordering of each unique test
Assessment requiring an independent historian

categories.name: Category 2: Independent interpretation of tests
categories.requirement: Independent interpretation of a test performed by another physician/other qualified health care professional (not separately reported)

categories.name: Category 3: Discussion of management or test interpretation
categories.requirement: Discussion of management or test interpretation with external physician/other qualified health care professional/appropriate source (not separately reported)

risk_of_management.label: High risk of morbidity from additional diagnostic testing or treatment
examples: Drug therapy requiring intensive monitoring for toxicity
Decision regarding elective major surgery with identified patient or procedure risk factors
Decision not to resuscitate or to de-escalate care because of poor prognosis
